profile_text.body:
High-Flyer is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in Hangzhou, China. Its website describes the company as focused on frontier technology research and development, using AI to inspire creativity and imagination. It presents itself as three connected efforts: the Firefly (萤火) deep learning training platform, High-Flyer Quant, a hedge fund that uses AI for investing, and AI basic science research.

The site describes Firefly Two as built around task-level time-sharing, with a scheduling system that responds in seconds so that each researcher has a smooth training experience. It also lists a software layer: a high-performance operator library (hfai.nn), a distributed training communication framework (hfreduce), and 3FS, a large-capacity, high-bandwidth file system built for AI development. According to the company, these let AI models scale across multiple nodes for large-scale parallel training.

The available record contains no litigation involving the company.
